# Qartmina

> Qartmina is an AI studio based in Nice, France. It trains teams to work with AI and puts integrated, robust AI into production for SMEs, agencies and startups: it finds the AI use cases that pay off most for a business, builds them, and puts the first one into production within a month. The work is done by seasoned, affordable engineers, mainly from North Africa and French-speaking, led by senior Qartmina project leads who check every deliverable. Qartmina is an OpenAI Select Partner.

Website languages: French (default) and English. Region: Nice and the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (PACA) region first, remote across France.

## Offers

- [AI for your operations](https://www.qartmina.com/en/expertises/ai-operations): invoices, quotes, purchase orders and contracts read, checked and filed automatically; documents sorted from e-mail, CRM and shared folders; reports written; checks done; AI assistants that answer from the company's own documents. Flagship offer.
- [AI training and consulting](https://www.qartmina.com/en/expertises/ai-training): teams already use AI, each on their own. Qartmina trains employees role by role on their real tasks (good prompts, the right tools, data rules), teaches them to connect AI to their tools and build reusable skills for repetitive tasks, and runs workshops to find the use cases that pay off most.
- [AI for your marketing and launches](https://www.qartmina.com/en/expertises/ai-marketing): content plans and posts, 2D and 3D visuals, launch videos, launch pages and online shops, produced with AI tools fed with the client's brand guidelines and tone.
- [Engineers on demand](https://www.qartmina.com/en/expertises/engineers): team reinforcement, one-off expert missions (ship a feature, move to the cloud), and an AI advisor for a few days to help a client's team add AI to its product.

## How we work

1. Week 1: understand the need and pick the use case that pays off most.
2. Week 2: design the solution (what AI does, what a person approves, which tools to connect).
3. Weeks 3 and 4: build, test on real data and put into production in the client's tools.
4. Then: train the team, measure the gain, add the next use cases.
